description: This file implements a service class for writing Article and Chunk entities into a Neo4j graph database, including schema constraints and write operations with idempotency. It manages connections, schema setup, and batch writing of articles with associated chunks and optional embeddings.

classes.name: Neo4jWriter
classes.description: A class that facilitates writing articles and chunks into a Neo4j database, handling connection setup, schema enforcement, and data writing with idempotency.

methods.name: str _hash_chunk_id(article_title: str, index: int, text: str)
methods.description: Generate a SHA-256 hash used as a unique identifier for a chunk based on article title, index, and a snippet of text.

methods.description: Constructor for Neo4jWriter; initializes connection parameters and driver instance.

methods.name: Driver _get_driver(self)
methods.description: Lazily initializes and retrieves the Neo4j driver instance.

methods.name: _ensure_schema(self, session: Session)
methods.description: Creates constraints and indexes for Article and Chunk nodes if they do not exist.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] write_article_with_chunks( self, title: str, url: str, chunks: Sequence[Dict[str, object]], embeddings: Optional[Sequence[Sequence[float]]] = None, store_embeddings: bool = True, )
methods.description: Primary method to write an article node with associated chunk nodes and relationships into Neo4j, with optional embedding storage.
